description: Extract article text, author, date, tags, sentiment, and images from any blog or news URL with multi-page support (Diffbot)

maxTags.description: Maximum number of topic tags to return (1-50, default 10)

paging.description: Follow multi-page articles and concatenate text (default true)

url.description: Article or blog post URL to extract text, author, and metadata

name: diffbot.articles.extract

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.
